# Servant Leadership: Strengths, Weaknesses, and a Path Forward

**Authors:** Robert C. Liden, Daan van Knippenberg  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Leadership Quarterly  
**DOI:** [10.1177/10596011251338133](https://doi.org/10.1177/10596011251338133)

## Abstract

A critical examination of servant leadership theory, identifying its conceptual strengths and weaknesses, and proposing a path forward for theoretical refinement and empirical research advancement.
